SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ec ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
WHERE ec."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hc."colour" = 'Blond';

SELECT DISTINCT p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" LIKE 'Abomination';

SELECT
    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "gender" AS g
    ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
JOIN "publisher" AS p
    ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" AS ec
    ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" AS hc
    ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" AS sc
    ON sc."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT AVG(s."height_cm") AS average_height
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "race" r ON s."race_id" = r."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics'
  AND r."race" <> 'Human';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS "count"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
  AND ha."attribute_value" = 100;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND sp."power_name" = 'Agility';

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."id" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(a."id")::numeric) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE a."id" = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT g."gender"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
WHERE sp."power_name" LIKE '%Phoenix Force%';

SELECT s."height_cm"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Amber';

SELECT a."element"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE a."atom_id" = 'TR004_7'
  AND m."label" = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m."molecule_id"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
  AND b."bond_type" = '-'
ORDER BY m."molecule_id" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS count
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE LOWER(a."element") = 'na'
  AND m."label" = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "connected" c ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '='
ORDER BY a."element" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT b."bond_type"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_8' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_20' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_8');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS "count"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '+'
  AND LOWER(a."element") = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."molecule_id",
    a."element"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b
    ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
JOIN "atom" a
    ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
ORDER BY m."molecule_id" ASC NULLS FIRST, a."element" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT b."bond_type"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE (c."atom_id" = 'TR000_1' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c."atom_id" = 'TR000_2' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR000_1');

SELECT
    a."atom_id",
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b."bond_type")
     FROM "bond" b
     WHERE b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id") AS bond_type_count
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" LIKE '%TR346%'
ORDER BY a."atom_id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
    m."label",
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a."element") = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
        / COUNT(a."atom_id") AS ratio
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m."label";

SELECT
    b."bond_type",
    b."bond_id"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE SUBSTR(c."atom_id", 7, 2)::int = 45
   OR SUBSTR(c."atom_id2", 7, 2)::int = 45

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."bond_id") AS connections_count
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
WHERE a."atom_id" LIKE 'TR%\_19' ESCAPE '\';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mj."major_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "major" mj ON mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
WHERE e."cost" > 100
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, mj."major_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC
    AS ratio
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND e."event_name" IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(p."tags") LIKE '%<r>%' THEN p."id" END)::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(COUNT(p."id"), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = p."owneruserid"
WHERE u."displayname" LIKE 'Community';

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."type" NOT LIKE '%fundrais%'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING COUNT(a."link_to_member") > 20
ORDER BY e."event_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" LIKE '%Elijah%'
  AND m."last_name" LIKE '%Allen%'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e."expense_date") IN (9, 10);

WITH top_user AS (
    SELECT u."id"
    FROM "users" u
    ORDER BY u."reputation" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(p."id") AS total_posts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p."score" > 50 THEN 1 END) AS posts_above_50
    FROM "posts" p
    JOIN top_user tu ON p."owneruserid" = tu."id"
)

SELECT
    (stats.posts_above_50::NUMERIC / NULLIF(stats.total_posts, 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM stats;
